verdict.rationale: Angular's own CLI lets you test outside production: `ng test` runs unit tests, `ng serve` and `ng e2e` build and serve the app locally for end-to-end tests, and an in-browser playground needs no project setup. None of this is documented as a sandbox that isolates you from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolated or mock data environments (e.g., HTTP mocking or test backends), any statement about separation from production data, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, independent corroboration.
